summary.zh-CN: 用 val 声明不可重新赋值的引用，用 var 表示可重新赋值的变量；默认先写 val，确实需要修改时再换用 var。
summary.en: Use val for references that cannot be reassigned and var for variables that can; start with val and switch to var only when reassignment is needed.

zh-CN: 写出 val 与 var 声明并解释两者区别
判断哪些变量应默认使用 val
en: Write val and var declarations and explain the difference
Decide which variables should default to val

prompt.zh-CN: 把一段全部用 var 声明的代码改成默认 val，只保留一个确实需要重新赋值的 var，并写出保留理由。
prompt.en: Rewrite a snippet that declares everything with var so that val is the default, keep var only for the one value that truly changes, and write down why it stays var.

hint.zh-CN: 逐个变量问自己：它在当前作用域内会被重新赋值吗？不会就写 val。
hint.en: For each variable ask whether it is reassigned inside its scope; if not, declare it with val.

summary.zh-CN: Kotlin 根据初始值推断局部变量类型；在公共 API 和容易混淆的类型处显式标注更清晰。
summary.en: Kotlin infers local variable types from initializers; explicit annotations are clearer at public API boundaries and where the type is easy to misread.

zh-CN: 解释局部变量类型推断的规则
在公共 API 处选用显式类型标注
en: Explain how local type inference works
Choose explicit type annotations at public API boundaries

prompt.zh-CN: 给三个局部变量声明补上推断出的类型，再指出其中哪个应改成显式标注并说明理由。
prompt.en: Write down the inferred type of three local declarations, then point out which one should be annotated explicitly and why.

hint.zh-CN: 整数默认 Int、小数默认 Double；公共函数返回值与空集合建议显式标注。
hint.en: Integers default to Int and decimals to Double; annotate public return types and empty collections explicitly.

summary.zh-CN: Kotlin 在类型系统中区分 String 与 String?，用安全调用、Elvis 操作符和智能转换代替空指针判断。
summary.en: Kotlin separates String from String? in the type system and replaces null-pointer checks with safe calls, the Elvis operator and smart casts.

zh-CN: 区分可空类型与非空类型
用 ?. 与 ?: 处理缺失值
说明 !! 的风险并避免滥用
en: Tell nullable and non-nullable types apart
Handle missing values with ?. and ?:
Explain the risk of !! and avoid overusing it

prompt.zh-CN: 把一段 Java 风格的空判断改写成安全调用与 Elvis 链，并说明哪些情况仍然需要显式分支。
prompt.en: Rewrite a Java-style null check as a safe-call and Elvis chain, and explain which cases still need an explicit branch.

hint.zh-CN: 返回默认值用 ?:；只在必须区分空与非空时写 if 分支；尽量删掉 !!。
hint.en: Use ?: to supply a default, keep an if branch only when null and non-null need different behavior, and remove !! where possible.

summary.zh-CN: when 是可返回值的多分支表达式，配合密封类可让编译器检查分支是否穷尽。
summary.en: when is a multi-branch expression that returns a value; combined with sealed classes the compiler checks that every branch is covered.

zh-CN: 把 when 当作表达式返回结果
用密封类让 when 分支穷尽
en: Use when as an expression that returns a value
Make when exhaustive with sealed classes

prompt.zh-CN: 为 when 补一个分支，然后删掉 else，观察编译器如何提示穷尽性。
prompt.en: Add a branch to a when, then delete its else branch and observe how the compiler reports exhaustiveness.

hint.zh-CN: 用密封类或 enum 时不需要 else，编译器会在新增子类时提示补分支。
hint.en: With a sealed class or enum no else is needed; the compiler reports a missing branch when a subtype is added.

summary.zh-CN: 函数在 Kotlin 中是一等值：Lambda 可作为参数与返回值，支持尾随 Lambda 写法与隐式参数 it。
summary.en: Functions are first-class values in Kotlin: lambdas can be arguments and return values, with trailing-lambda syntax and the implicit it parameter.

zh-CN: 写接受函数参数的高阶函数
识别并使用尾随 Lambda 与 it
en: Write a higher-order function that takes a function parameter
Recognize and use trailing lambdas and the implicit it

prompt.zh-CN: 写一个 repeatTwice(action) 高阶函数，并用尾随 Lambda 调用它。
prompt.en: Write a repeatTwice(action) higher-order function and call it with a trailing lambda.

hint.zh-CN: 参数类型写成 () -> Unit；最后一个参数是函数时可以把 Lambda 写到括号外。
hint.en: Use () -> Unit as the parameter type; when the last parameter is a function you can move the lambda outside the parentheses.

summary.zh-CN: data class 自动生成 equals、hashCode、toString、copy 与解构，适合承载数据而非行为。
summary.en: A data class generates equals, hashCode, toString, copy and destructuring, which makes it a good fit for carrying data instead of behavior.

zh-CN: 定义 data class 并用 copy 修改单个字段
用解构声明读取字段
en: Define a data class and modify one field with copy
Read fields with destructuring declarations

prompt.zh-CN: 把一段手工写 equals/toString 的类改写成 data class，并证明两个同值实例相等但修改副本后不相等。
prompt.en: Rewrite a class with hand-written equals/toString as a data class, then show that two equal-value instances compare equal while an edited copy does not.

hint.zh-CN: data class 主构造参数即属性；修改字段用 copy(name = ...) 得到新实例。
hint.en: Primary-constructor parameters become properties; change a field with copy(name = ...) to get a new instance.

summary.zh-CN: Kotlin 类默认 final，用 open/abstract 开启继承；接口定义可实现的契约，单继承多实现。
summary.en: Kotlin classes are final by default and need open/abstract to be inherited; interfaces define contracts, with single inheritance and multiple implementations.

zh-CN: 解释 final、open、abstract 的使用场景
用接口抽象变化并实现两种实现
en: Explain when to use final, open and abstract
Abstract a variation behind an interface and implement two versions

prompt.zh-CN: 为一个日志输出点定义接口 Logger，写控制台和内存两个实现，并在调用处只依赖接口。
prompt.en: Define a Logger interface for a logging point, implement a console version and an in-memory version, and make the caller depend only on the interface.

hint.zh-CN: 接口方法不写实现即强制实现者提供；默认实现可放在接口里减少重复。
hint.en: A method without a body forces implementers to provide it; default implementations in the interface reduce duplication.

summary.zh-CN: 扩展函数在不修改原类的情况下为已有类型添加可调用函数，按静态类型解析。
summary.en: Extension functions add callable functions to existing types without modifying them, resolved by static type.

zh-CN: 为已有类型写扩展函数
解释扩展函数的静态解析与作用域限制
en: Write an extension function for an existing type
Explain static resolution and scope limits of extension functions

prompt.zh-CN: 给 String 写一个 isEmail() 扩展函数并用它过滤列表，再说明为什么它不能覆盖成员函数。
prompt.en: Write an isEmail() extension on String, use it to filter a list, and explain why it cannot override a member function.

hint.zh-CN: 接收者写在函数名前，例如 fun String.isEmail()；成员函数始终优先于同签名扩展函数。
hint.en: Put the receiver before the function name, e.g. fun String.isEmail(); member functions always win over an extension with the same signature.

summary.zh-CN: Kotlin 标准库用 map 转换、filter 过滤、fold 聚合，所有操作返回新集合，避免手写循环与可变累加器。
summary.en: The Kotlin standard library transforms with map, filters with filter and aggregates with fold; operations return new collections, so hand-written loops and mutable accumulators are rarely needed.

zh-CN: 用 map/filter 链式处理集合
用 fold 替代可变累加器
区分 List 与 MutableList 的读写意图
en: Process collections with map/filter chains
Replace a mutable accumulator with fold
Distinguish read-only List from MutableList intent

prompt.zh-CN: 给定一组价格字符串，用 map/filter/fold 求出可打折商品的总价，不写显式循环。
prompt.en: Given a list of price strings, compute the total of discounted items with map/filter/fold and no explicit loop.

hint.zh-CN: 先用 mapNotNull 解析字符串，再 filter，最后 fold(0) { acc, v -> acc + v }。
hint.en: Parse with mapNotNull, filter, then fold(0) { acc, v -> acc + v }.

summary.zh-CN: Sequence 惰性求值，链式操作不产生中间集合，适合大数据或提前短路。
summary.en: Sequence evaluates lazily: chained operations produce no intermediate collections, which suits large data or early termination.

zh-CN: 解释 Sequence 与集合链式操作的区别
在适合的场景改用 asSequence
en: Explain the difference between Sequence and collection chains
Switch to asSequence in suitable cases

prompt.zh-CN: 把一段多次遍历的集合处理改成 Sequence，并说明它和集合处理的输出是否一致。
prompt.en: Rewrite a multi-pass collection pipeline as a Sequence and state whether its output matches the eager version.

hint.zh-CN: 用 asSequence() 开始、toList() 结束；中间不产生 List，但输出顺序保持一致。
hint.en: Start with asSequence() and finish with toList(); no intermediate lists are created, but the output order stays the same.

summary.zh-CN: suspend 函数在等待时挂起而不阻塞线程；协程由调度器决定在哪个线程恢复，适合网络与 IO。
summary.en: A suspend function suspends instead of blocking a thread while waiting; the dispatcher decides where the coroutine resumes, which suits network and IO work.

zh-CN: 区分挂起与阻塞
用 launch/async 启动协程并等待结果
en: Distinguish suspending from blocking
Start coroutines with launch/async and await results

prompt.zh-CN: 把一个阻塞的 Thread.sleep 调用改成 suspend 的 delay，并说明为什么这样不阻塞线程。
prompt.en: Replace a blocking Thread.sleep call with a suspending delay and explain why the thread is no longer blocked.

hint.zh-CN: delay 挂起协程并让出线程；runBlocking 只用于教学或 main 入口，不用于业务代码。
hint.en: delay suspends the coroutine and releases the thread; use runBlocking only for teaching or main entry points, not business code.

summary.zh-CN: 协程必须在作用域内启动：父作用域等待子协程完成，取消与异常按层级传播，泄漏任务更难发生。
summary.en: Coroutines must start inside a scope: the parent waits for children, cancellation and exceptions propagate along the hierarchy, and leaked tasks become rare.

zh-CN: 解释 CoroutineScope 与 Job 的父子关系
在取消或异常时正确清理子协程
en: Explain the parent-child relationship between CoroutineScope and Job
Clean up child coroutines on cancellation or failure

prompt.zh-CN: 写一个同时发起两个请求的 coroutineScope，让其中一个失败时两个都被取消，并说明如何只保留成功结果。
prompt.en: Write a coroutineScope that starts two requests, cancels both when either fails, and explain how to keep only successful results.

hint.zh-CN: coroutineScope 内子协程失败会取消同级；需要互不影响时用 supervisorScope。
hint.en: Inside coroutineScope a failing child cancels its siblings; use supervisorScope when failures must be isolated.

title.zh-CN: Java 互操作与平台类型

summary.zh-CN: 调用 Java API 时出现平台类型 T!：可空性未知，Kotlin 不强制空检查，需要显式断言或标注。
summary.en: Java APIs surface as platform types such as T!: nullability is unknown, so Kotlin does not enforce null checks and you must annotate or assert explicitly.

zh-CN: 识别平台类型并说明它与可空类型的区别
在 Java 边界显式声明可空性
en: Recognize platform types and contrast them with nullable types
Declare nullability explicitly at Java boundaries

prompt.zh-CN: 给一个返回平台值的 Java 方法调用加上显式可空类型与 Elvis 默认值，并说明为什么不能直接依赖 !!。
prompt.en: Add an explicit nullable type and an Elvis default to a call returning a platform value, and explain why !! is not a safe substitute.

hint.zh-CN: 写成 val s: String? = javaApi.find() 再处理；!! 会在运行时抛 NPE，编译器无法提前发现。
hint.en: Write val s: String? = javaApi.find() and handle it; !! throws at runtime, which the compiler cannot catch early.
